description:
Vehicle lookup by Dutch license plate (kenteken) — Pro / extended response

Returns vehicle registration data from the RDW Basisregistratie Voertuigen,
enriched with fuel + emission information, a national milieuzone compliance
flag, and a wide range of extended fields: catalogusprijs, dimensions,
weight limits, body type, axle data and EV-specific specs (range, consumption,
continuous power). Results are cached for 24 hours.

In addition to the subset fields, the response contains the `rdw` block with
the complete source rows from all four RDW Open Data datasets (Kenteken
Voertuigen, Brandstof, Carrosserie, Assen); no field is omitted. Columns that
RDW leaves empty for a vehicle are `null`.

RDW records fuel with one row per fuel type (ordered by `brandstof_volgnummer`).
`fuel_type` is the primary fuel (sequence number 1); `fuel_types` contains all
registered fuels and `hybrid` is `true` as soon as there is more than one fuel
(for example Petrol + Electricity). This distinguishes a hybrid car from a pure
combustion or EV car.

The `allowed_in_green_zones` flag is derived from the emission class and fuel type
using Dutch national milieuzone standards (2024–2025):

— Electric / hydrogen / CNG: always allowed

— Petrol (any Euro class): allowed

— Diesel Euro 6+: allowed

— Diesel Euro 5 and below: not allowed

— Unknown fuel or emission class: `null`

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: rdw.vehicle
